scope: independent root audit of the fixed-prime phase interval, constant-term and residue representation, algebraicity and recurrence consequence, divided same-characteristic transport, CRT countermodel, sharp threshold, replay, and capacity interpretation

checks.root_repairs: Canonicalized paths, deterministic output, and replay instructions. No mathematical repair was required.

mathematical_audit.fixed_prime_column: Solving the two tied equations gives h=3M-2p and s=(3p-4M-1)/2. The positivity interval has exactly floor(p/12) integers for every prime p>3, with consecutive shift (M,h,s)->(M+1,h+3,s-2).
mathematical_audit.constant_term: The displayed w_nu and K reproduce Item 197's coefficient as CT_z w_nu K^M, and summing geometrically yields the rational constant-term generating function.
mathematical_audit.residue_algebraicity: After multiplication by dz/z the integrand is N_nu/Delta. Four roots of Delta tend to zero; their residue sum is the generating function. The product over all four-subset residue sums is symmetric in the twelve roots, giving a nonzero annihilator over Q(t) of Y-degree at most 495.
mathematical_audit.recurrence: An algebraic power series is D-finite. Clearing a linear differential relation and comparing coefficients gives a homogeneous polynomial-coefficient recurrence of absolute order and degree, independent of p.
mathematical_audit.divided_transport: On a recurrence window contained in I_p every C_nu term has the same compulsory p factor. Dividing the integral recurrence by p and reducing modulo p gives exact same-characteristic transport of the divided coordinates; no invertibility is claimed at singular steps.
mathematical_audit.information_no_go: The recurrence operators do not couple different prime columns. Their homogeneous output equations admit zero output on every column, and CRT combines those solutions into the full candidate-support countermodel.
mathematical_audit.threshold: For D asymptotic to log M, Item 400's full-support witness has clustered coefficient at least 1/12, exactly saturating rather than beating Item 395's strict admission threshold.
mathematical_audit.scope: The countermodel is not the actual distinguished recurrence orbit. Actual initial-state arithmetic, cross-prime reciprocity, a common low-height carrier, or a horizontal distribution theorem remains outside the closed class.
